summary: Antalpha Platform Holding Co filed a Form 6-K on May 19, 2026, attaching a press release reporting its unaudited first quarter 2026 financial results. The release highlights revenue of $20.7 million (up 52% YoY), net income of $2.7 million (up 85% YoY), and adjusted EBITDA of $13.3 million (up 435% YoY). The filing includes operational metrics for supply chain and margin loan TVL, and references the acquisition of a controlling interest in Aurelion on October 10, 2025. This is a routine earnings disclosure. No transaction terms, deal structure, or strategic event are present. What to watch: no special situation impact.
